title: Intergrate xDrip Sync method to AAPSClient, without the need for xDrip.
symptom: A user wants to use AAPSClient as a follower without installing xDrip, but currently must install xDrip to see BG data via xDrip Sync.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; it discusses the request and clarifies that xDrip Sync uses its own service (Bluejay) and requires the same key between master and follower phones.
fix: The thread does not provide a resolution; maintainers state that xDrip follow functionality cannot be integrated into AAPS and suggest talking to xDrip developers about a simpler client app.
evidence_quote: We can't integrate xDrip into AAPS(Client) just so that you don't need to install 2nd application. Follow functionality of xDrip is not that simple and it shouldn't be in AAPS.
